decisions.what: Build mode: ultra-bare-bones (token 'ultra bare bones design:' opens the brief)
decisions.why: reference/build-modes.md scope contract: ONE functional block (24V->5V/2A buck) plus only datasheet-required support; one input + one output interface (screw terminals); no protection/filtering/indicators/test points beyond the block's own need; defaults = fewest honest layers, JLC PCBA single-sided, qty 5, bench 0-50C, stop at P9. Research mandatory: first coverage call of each phase runs --maturity-floor proven --research-provisional.

decisions.what: Input ceiling: 30 V is a HARD maximum operating input; converter chosen with Vin absolute-max >= 36 V class (~20% headroom) as selection headroom only - no added clamp parts
decisions.why: Owner answered P0 Q1 with the default. Keeps VIN-GND at/below 30 V so check_creepage stays a no-op and IPC-2221 spacing does not bind the layout; the mode excludes an input clamp so the IC rating is the only defense.

decisions.what: No live hot-plug of the input: wires land first, supply ramps from zero
decisions.why: Owner answered P0 Q2 with the default. Removes the ~2x lead-inductance ringing case (~60 V from 30 V) from the requirement set; datasheet-required bulk input capacitance damps the incidental case, no damping component added.

decisions.what: Output spec: +/-3% DC (4.85-5.15 V) over 18-30 Vin and 0-2 A load; ripple <= 50 mV peak-to-peak
decisions.why: Owner answered P0 Q3 with the default. Sets the regulation/ripple targets that bind feedback divider tolerance, output capacitance and the P8 sim bounds.

decisions.what: One switch-node probe pad plus an adjacent GND pad; no other test points
decisions.why: Owner answered P0 Q4 with the default. Mode-boundary ruling: the switch node is the block's own measurement need on a study board whose bring-up evidence proves the seeded records. Kept minimal and inside the existing SW polygon to limit added copper on the noisiest node.

decisions.what: P1 research roster: research-power-architect + research-component-scout(buck-regulator) only. NO research-interface-spec, NO research-reference-design.
decisions.why: Screw terminals are bound by no electrical standard, so there is no interface spec to research. The buck block is not novel - the library already holds 16 buck records - and the useful vendor-layout digest is exactly what the P3 part-level coverage research produces for the CHOSEN IC; a P1 reference-design spawn would duplicate it. Mode says do not pad.

spawns.note: MODEL SUBSTITUTION: tier fable/high unavailable (Fable 5 out of usage credits) -> opus/xhigh per SKILL.md availability rule. Applies to all fable-tier spawns this run.
